topics.title: Hurricane Isaias nears Gulf Coast
topics.summary: Isaias strengthened into a major hurricane as Gulf Coast communities prepared for dangerous surge, heavy rain and possible late changes before landfall.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a storm forecast keeps shifting, who trusts the cone map and who starts packing snacks before anyone asks?

topics.title: Warm Gulf waters fuel storm debate
topics.summary: Scientists say unusually warm Gulf water helped Isaias intensify, while El Nino wind shear may still weaken it before landfall.
topics.discussionPrompt: If warm water and wind shear are wrestling over a hurricane, who narrates it like sports and who just checks the rain boots?

topics.title: US stocks cap record week
topics.summary: U.S. stocks rose Friday toward the end of a record-setting week, even as bond, oil and technology shares kept investors cautious.
topics.discussionPrompt: When markets break records but everyone still sounds nervous, who celebrates and who checks what the fine print is hiding?

topics.title: Navi Pillay wins peace Nobel
topics.summary: Former UN rights chief and ICJ judge Navi Pillay won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for work promoting international law and accountability.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a peace prize honors legal accountability, who wants courtroom details and who asks whether it actually changes behavior?

topics.title: Flights paused after Riyadh attack claim
topics.summary: Airlines suspended flights to Saudi Arabia's capital after Houthis claimed an airport attack; Saudi officials had confirmed deaths from strikes earlier in the week.
topics.discussionPrompt: When airport routes suddenly change, who studies the regional map and who wonders how many suitcases are now in limbo?

topics.title: Italian winery hit by huge theft
topics.summary: Reports say thieves stole about 30,000 wine bottles worth roughly 5 million euros from a Florence-area winery in a major heist.
topics.discussionPrompt: If someone steals a mountain of fancy wine, who imagines an elaborate caper and who asks where you even hide 30,000 bottles?

topics.title: Cyberpunk 2077 heads to film
topics.summary: Paramount is set to adapt Cyberpunk 2077 into a live-action movie, extending the game franchise beyond consoles and streaming animation.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a huge game becomes a movie, who casts it immediately and who worries the neon city will steal every scene?

topics.title: Japan succession debate grows
topics.summary: Calls are growing in Japan to let Princess Aiko take the throne as the imperial family faces a shrinking pool of male heirs.
topics.discussionPrompt: When tradition runs into a practical family math problem, who defends the old rule and who asks why not update it?

topics.title: Climate finance pressure rises before Cop31
topics.summary: Australia's prime minister urged wealthy countries to spend much more on climate action than defense as Cop31 diplomacy gathered pace.
topics.discussionPrompt: If climate budgets and defense budgets sat at the same table, who would ask for receipts and who would rearrange the priorities?

topics.title: Star Wars prop goes to auction
topics.summary: The lightsaber used in Darth Vader's famous Empire Strikes Back duel is going up for auction, drawing attention from film memorabilia collectors.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a legendary movie prop goes on sale, who calls it priceless history and who asks whether it comes with display batteries?
